scope: qualitative cognitive audit, separate from core runtime; strong shared P0 specification deliberately limits requirement-discovery inference

dimensions.name: scope and traceability
dimensions.question: Do implementation/docs distinguish declared complete P0 from later/inapplicable capabilities, without omissions disguised as future work?

dimensions.name: decisions and reasons
dimensions.question: Are actual defaults coherent with code, alternatives/tradeoffs justified, rather than unsupported best-practice slogans?

dimensions.name: phase roadmap
dimensions.question: Does P0 complete the journey and do later increments serve this user without gratuitous enterprise feature scope?

dimensions.name: human questions
dimensions.question: Are important unknowns and real decision triggers identified, while answered/reversible choices proceed?

dimensions.name: evidence honesty
dimensions.question: Do docs distinguish authored claims, not_run and actual behavior, without invented research/license/runtime facts?

optional_maturity: Record additional considered permissions/billing/admin/audit/data-lifecycle topics only if appropriate; no hidden mandatory feature list or numeric feature-count winner.
